scope: Current rebuilt private core: QEMU HIGH/LOW physical COMMAND/EDLIN editing, saved/reopened text, redirection, FIND and rendered CP775 glyphs; national short-name batch workflows, country DIR ordering, raw FAT entries and fresh-boot read/cleanup. Every Baltic language is required. Real-BIOS workflows, installed text/files and full release/reproducibility on this core remain separate gates.
